originalSourceText:
Q.10  In the Transpose-Jacobian Cartesian Controller, how is the virtual

      Cartesian force 𝐹 converted into joint torques?

     A) 𝜏= 𝐽−1𝐹

     B) 𝜏= 𝐹𝐽

     C) 𝜏= 𝐽𝑇𝐹

     D) 𝜏= 𝐹/𝐽

     Answer: C

      Refer to Lecture 25: Cartesian-Based Control Systems and Examples

      Slide 11
